data.one_liner: Flutter package for customizable confetti overlays and widgets
data.what_it_does: Provides APIs to launch confetti animations as overlays or widgets, with support for emojis, custom widgets, presets, and physics tuning.
use_when: Adding visual feedback to user actions
Creating game win or level-up effects
avoid_when: You need a full particle engine with physics simulation beyond confetti
You require low-level control over particle emission timing
strengths: Easy one-line API for quick overlays
Rich preset system for common celebration types
Supports custom widget sprites and emoji particles
weaknesses: Limited to confetti-style effects, not a general particle system
No built-in support for complex physics or custom shaders
Documentation focuses on high-level usage, may need deeper exploration for advanced tuning

alternatives.name: lottie
alternatives.why_pick_it: Use for complex animated graphics beyond confetti
